name: Crepax Cinematic Gutter Inference
description: Guido Crepax Valentina-era comics style. Nouvelle-vague cinematic panel fragmentation on a graphic-narrative multi-cell page. Dense grid of micro-panels isolating eyes, lips, hands, fabric edges. Elegant nervous pen line with clustered hatching. Incomplete faces, obsessive clothing detail. Aggressive negative space (large pure white or solid black fields) that isolates the charged fragment. Erotic charge assembled by the reader across the gutters. Fashion-photography contact-sheet layout of a single slowed moment.
